reviews.title: A great solid case for the money and looks!!!
reviews.comment: Case is amazing. It looks solid. And for how solid it looks it’s not heavy at all. There is tons of space for cable management. It looks clean and lots of fans. It looks tool less and screw less for the most part and it will be easy for my son to build his first time PC. It was very affordable and the case is solid and good quality material. A right mixture of plastic, glass in order to see the work and metal. I love that the PSU will be hidden once it’s built.
reviews.author: Kami Pereira

reviews.title: Excellent case and overall value for the price!
reviews.comment: Fantastic case at a very reasonable price. Plenty of room for wiring and my system's components. The fans are pretty quiet while still providing great airflow. The case fits in my leg mount adapter on my Secretlab Magnus Pro and complements the overall aesthetic of the desk with its sleek and classy look. The ventilation is excellent, and I removed the feet to optimize the look since its mounted. I had to use some tape to cover the open holes left by the mounting dowels for the feet, but no big deal. I especially enjoy how functional the glass side panel is for supporting easy removal and replacement for quick access to my system's components. The unit came pretty much fully assembled, so set up really boiled down to transferring my system components from the old case to the new one. All ports and wiring worked as they should OOTB. I am extremely pleased with this purchase overall!
reviews.author: Bill

reviews.title: Really good for the price
reviews.comment: Plenty of space, good looking fans with good airflow and cooling. Very quiet, can sometimes make a faint, almost angelic hum which I find quite pleasent. Thin metal, but is smoothed down so you don’t cut yourself. Plenty of space in the drive bay, and the SSD mounts are a nice touch. Cable management system is nothing special but gets the job done, and I appreciated that it came with zip ties for this. It can be hard to plug stuff into the bottom motherboard headers (if you are using ATX) so I recommend removing or pushing out of the way. the bottom fans before building. One thing is that the fans are daisy chained with a non-standard connector, but unless you plan to replace them while keeping some of the original, this shouldn’t be too much of an issue. Overall excellent case for the price, would recommend.
reviews.author: Isaiah Nabatian

reviews.title: Great deal on a good 6 fan case 2 thumbs up
reviews.comment: It is a light weight case but fully functional. Great budget build in a stylish 6 included fan case. It has Newer ARGB 5V light harness so you need a converter from 12V to 5V on older RGB motherboards. Other than that everything went well. I even moved the 3 bottom fans to top where they actually mover more air. The wiring is short on the fans so had to spin the 2 side fans to daisy chain all 6 together. Large bottom area if longer power supply. The Drive tray is removable and has 2 SSD drive holders on the back motherboard mounting plate area. Two Thumbs Up for $70.
reviews.author: GZ

reviews.title: Extra Wide - Great for Large CPU Coolers!
reviews.comment:
This is a good quality case and I am glad I went with this as it was wide enough for my CPU cooler. I wish it came with extra fan screws, as I purchased extra fans but couldn't install as neither came with hardware haha. Otherwise is quiet, no vibrations.
Overall arrangement is good, lots of options for cable management. The two glass walls make for a gorgeous view of the interior. No assembly required on the case. The removable glass panel is a bit hard to pry away, but it goes back together with ease.
reviews.author: Ben
